overview.en: Cymothoa exigua is a marine isopod assigned to the fish-parasitic family Cymothoidae.
overview.fr: Cymothoa exigua est un isopode marin de la famille des Cymothoidae, parasites de poissons.

identification.en: The flattened, segmented crustacean has hooked legs for anchoring; females occupy the mouth while males have been found on the gills.
identification.fr: Ce crustacé aplati et segmenté possède des pattes crochues pour s’ancrer ; des femelles occupent la bouche tandis que des mâles ont été observés sur les branchies.

habitat.en: It parasitizes marine fishes in the eastern Pacific, including the spotted rose snapper Lutjanus guttatus.
habitat.fr: Il parasite des poissons marins du Pacifique oriental, dont le vivaneau rose Lutjanus guttatus.

diet.en: In two infected snappers, more than 90% of the tongue was absent. The authors proposed that the isopod might help hold food in the mouth, but did not demonstrate functional replacement.
diet.fr: Chez deux vivaneaux infestés, plus de 90 % de la langue manquait. Les auteurs ont proposé que l’isopode puisse aider à maintenir les aliments dans la bouche, sans démontrer un remplacement fonctionnel.

behavior.en: A Honduran survey recorded it on two fish hosts in the Gulf of Fonseca, with specimens attached in the mouth or on the gills.
behavior.fr: Une étude hondurienne l’a signalé sur deux poissons-hôtes dans le golfe de Fonseca, avec des spécimens fixés dans la bouche ou sur les branchies.

reproduction.en: Species-specific reproductive stages are poorly documented; cymothoid females generally brood developing embryos in a ventral marsupium.
reproduction.fr: Les stades reproducteurs propres à l’espèce sont peu documentés ; les femelles cymothoïdes incubent généralement leurs embryons dans un marsupium ventral.

ecology.en: It is one of many fish-parasitic isopods, but its buccal attachment and reported tongue atrophy distinguish it from gill- and skin-attaching relatives.
ecology.fr: C’est l’un des nombreux isopodes parasites de poissons, mais sa fixation buccale et l’atrophie linguale rapportée le distinguent des espèces branchiales ou cutanées.

conservation.en: The cited field observations document hosts and attachment, not a population trend.
conservation.fr: Les observations citées documentent les hôtes et les sites de fixation, pas une tendance des populations.

title.en: Tongue replacement in a marine fish (Lutjanus guttatus) by a parasitic isopod — Brusca & Gilligan, Copeia
title.fr: Remplacement de la langue d’un poisson marin (Lutjanus guttatus) par un isopode parasite — Brusca et Gilligan, Copeia

facts: Two infested snappers had more than 90% of the tongue absent; feeding-function replacement was proposed, not demonstrated.

title.en: Cymothoa exigua — Ocean Biodiversity Information System
title.fr: Cymothoa exigua — système d’information biogéographique océanique

facts: OBIS links this accepted species to WoRMS taxon 256755 and places it among marine cymothoid isopods.

title.en: Hooked on you: shape of attachment structures in cymothoid isopods reflects parasitic strategy — PeerJ
title.fr: Accrochés à l’hôte : les structures de fixation des isopodes cymothoïdes reflètent leur stratégie parasitaire — PeerJ

facts: The comparative study distinguishes mouth, gill, skin and flesh attachment among cymothoid isopods.

title.en: New records of fish-parasitic isopods in the eastern Pacific — UNED Research Journal
title.fr: Nouvelles mentions d’isopodes parasites de poissons du Pacifique oriental — revue de recherche de l’UNED

facts: A Honduran survey reports C. exigua on two fish hosts in the Gulf of Fonseca, attached in mouths and gills.

title.en: Global diversity of fish-parasitic isopods in Cymothoidae — systematic review
title.fr: Diversité mondiale des isopodes parasites de poissons Cymothoidae — synthèse taxonomique

facts: The family review describes female cymothoids brooding embryos in a ventral marsupium.

uncertainties: The classic observation concerns two Lutjanus guttatus; the paper hypothesizes a possible feeding function for the isopod but does not demonstrate it.
Reproductive details here are family-level Cymothoidae information, not a complete species-specific account.
No close cymothoid profile was found in the current catalogue.
review_note: Revised against Brusca & Gilligan’s primary account: tongue degeneration is observed, while functional replacement remains a proposed hypothesis; blood-flow mechanism is not attributed to C. exigua. The Honduran record is used only for host and attachment occurrence.
